title: Lawsuit: Man used Grok to make 7K sex images of stepdaughter, then shot himself
brief: A man used Grok, XAI's AI model, to generate approximately 7,000 sexually exploitative images of his stepdaughter before taking his own life, according to a lawsuit. The case is part of a broader wave of legal action against X alleging that Grok facilitated the creation of child sexual abuse material (CSAM) and that the platform failed to prevent such abuse.
